iifou7:253: This article demonstrates the practical value of the "each handles one side" AI collaboration model in cross-cloud network setup. Claude Code handles learning the tccli command system on the Tencent Cloud side, generating VPN gateway and tunnel creation commands, and writing scripts to parse JSON output; Kiro CLI handles VGW creation, Customer Gateway configuration, VPN Connection tunnel parameter generation, route propagation settings, and security group configuration on the AWS side. The core advantage of this division is that each tool maintains context only for its own side, avoiding cross-platform conceptual confusion. Engineers focus on architecture decisions and parameter alignment rather than memorizing the syntax details of two CLI systems.
